mapper.sql: r.id, r.source, r.title, r.description, r.amount, r.currency, r.received_on, r.reference, r.related_type, r.related_id, r.recorded_by, r.notes, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, u.nick_name as rec_name
mapper.insert: insert into nad_revenue (source, title, description, amount, currency, received_on, reference, related_type, related_id, recorded_by, notes, create_by, create_time) values (#{source}, #{title}, #{description}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{receivedOn}, #{reference}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{recordedBy}, #{notes}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_revenue set source = #{source}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, amount = #{amount}, currency = #{currency}, received_on = #{receivedOn}, reference = #{reference}, related_type = #{relatedType}, related_id = #{relatedId}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from nad_revenue r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.recorded_by where r.id = #{id}
